t: Section 11 of such Act (7 U.S.C. 2331) is amended by striking out “specifications” and inserting in lieu thereof “descriptions”.

fable.w: This section is a purely technical amendment that substitutes one word for another in an existing statute. It establishes no comment period, hearing, advisory body, consultation with outside parties, rulemaking authority, or right to sue. There is no tempting reading here; nothing in the text involves any party outside the federal government in a federal decision.
fable.s: is amended by striking out “specifications” and inserting in lieu thereof “descriptions”.

opus.w: This section only replaces the word "specifications" with "descriptions" in Section 11 of an existing Act. It does not involve anyone outside the federal government in a federal decision: there is no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory committee, or right to sue. One could guess that the amended provision involves some process, but nothing in this text creates or describes one, so the answer is No.
